message.reasoning: We see fuelLevel 10.5 gallons? Actually metadata shows FuelRange 560 km remaining. But fuelLevel field is 10.5. Probably gallons. We need to estimate if 10.5 gallons enough for 750 miles. Need fuel consumption. We have average fuel consumption 8.2L/100km. Convert to mpg. 8.2 L per 100 km => 100 km = 62.137 miles. 8.2 L per 62.137 miles. 1 gallon = 3.78541 L. So fuel consumption in gallons per mile: 8.2 L / 62.137 mi = 0.132 L/mi. Convert to gallons: 0.132 L/mi * (1 gal / 3.78541 L) = 0.0349 gal/mi. So mpg = 1 / 0.0349 = 28.66 mpg. For 750 miles, fuel needed = 750 / 28.66 = 26.18 gallons. We have only 10.5 gallons. So not enough. But we could also use estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage. Let's call that.
